name: video-template-character-roster-reveal
title: Character Roster Reveal
description: A 10-12 second hero lineup reveal for a trailer or announcement: each playable character gets a short beat with a signature pose and ability flash, then all of them snap into a final lineup hold. Works from text descriptions or attached character reference images.

description_i18n.en: A 10-12 second hero lineup reveal for a trailer or announcement: each playable character gets a short beat with a signature pose and ability flash, then all of them snap into a final lineup hold. Works from text descriptions or attached character reference images.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 一段 10–12 秒的英雄阵容展示，适用于预告片或公告：每个可玩角色依次登场，摆出招牌姿势并闪现技能，最后全部归位成阵容定格。可基于文字描述或附带的角色参考图生成。

query.en:
A 10 to 12 second character roster reveal for an indie game trailer.

Game: {argument name="game_pitch" default="a co-op dungeon crawler starring a band of misfit animal adventurers"}.
Art style: {argument name="art_style" default="stylised toon-shaded 3D with clean outlines and bold colour blocking"}.
Reference images: {argument name="reference_mode" default="if character reference images are attached, keep each character exactly on model, matching proportions, colours and costume details"}.
Characters, in order: {argument name="characters" default="1) a badger knight with a door-sized shield, 2) a heron archer with a longbow, 3) a raccoon tinkerer with a backpack of gadgets, 4) a moth mystic trailing glowing dust"}.

# Timeline
- 0-1s: an empty stage with a coloured light sweep and a hint of each character's colour.
- 1-9s: one beat of about 2 seconds per character: they step or leap into frame, strike a signature pose, and trigger a quick ability flash ({argument name="ability_flashes" default="a shield slam shockwave, an arrow volley, a gadget burst, a swirl of dust"}). Each beat uses that character's accent colour for the light.
- 9-12s: all characters snap into a final lineup side by side on one shared platform, equal spacing, heroic low-angle camera, and hold still for at least 1.5 seconds with a clean empty band above them for the game logo, added later.

# Look
- Camera: punchy push-ins on each pose, smooth whip transitions between characters.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="each character with one signature accent colour against a dark neutral stage"}.
- Sound: one rhythmic hit per character on the beat, a big chord on the lineup.

# Avoid
Generated names, text or stat panels, characters drifting off model between beats, extra or merged characters, real game or brand logos, watermarks.
